description: DTDL v2 schema for the hwinfo MetricType documented in docs/Metrics/03_HARDWARE_INFO_FIELDS.md. Every Telemetry is a constant-per-boot platform identity string read from the hardware-platform driver (e.g. Advantech SUSI). On unsupported hosts the values are suppressed (null), never empty strings.

schemas.description: Allowed MetricType discriminators in this Interface.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType == 'hwinfo'.
Allowed values of SensorGroup. hwinfo sensors conventionally use 'SYS'.
Allowed values of SensorInfo.Schema. For hwinfo every MetricName resolves to 'string'.

contents.name: HwinfoMotherboardName
contents.description: Mainboard model identifier from BIOS / platform driver. MetricType=hwinfo, MetricName=motherboardname.
contents.comment: Validation: non-empty ASCII; constant per boot. Drift between samples implies BIOS update or board swap -- log as identity change. null/suppressed on unsupported hosts (no driver).

contents.name: HwinfoManufacturer
contents.description: OEM string from SMBIOS / platform driver. MetricType=hwinfo, MetricName=manufacturer.
contents.comment: Validation: non-empty ASCII; constant per boot. Used for fleet-side filtering by vendor.

contents.name: HwinfoBiosRevision
contents.comment: Validation: non-empty string matching vendor versioning scheme (e.g. 'Vd.dd'). Change between samples implies a BIOS flash -- log as identity change.

contents.name: HwinfoDriverVersion
contents.description: Loaded hardware-platform kernel driver version (e.g. SUSI). MetricType=hwinfo, MetricName=driverversion.
contents.comment: Validation: non-empty 'd.d.dd' style string. Change between samples implies a driver reload -- log as identity change.

contents.name: HwinfoLibraryVersion
contents.description: Userspace platform SDK library version the agent links against. MetricType=hwinfo, MetricName=libraryversion.
contents.comment: Validation: non-empty string; constant per binary. Change between samples implies the agent was redeployed.

contents.name: HwinfoEcRevision
contents.description: Embedded-controller firmware revision (chassis / fan / sensor MCU). MetricType=hwinfo, MetricName=ecrevision.
contents.comment: Validation: non-empty string; constant per boot. Change between samples implies EC firmware update.
